Which statement about compounds is correct?
A
Covalent compounds are less volatile than ionic compounds.
B
Covalent compounds conduct electricity when they are solid.
C
Ionic compounds conduct electricity when molten.
D
Ionic compounds are insoluble in water.

options.label: A
options.text: Covalent compounds are less volatile than ionic compounds.

options.label: B
options.text: Covalent compounds conduct electricity when they are solid.

options.label: C
options.text: Ionic compounds conduct electricity when molten.

options.label: D
options.text: Ionic compounds are insoluble in water.
